_comment: Guardian Shield v9 policy. Two postures: (1) agent-containment (default, hardening_mode=false) restricts only AI-agent process subtrees against protected_paths; (2) hardening_mode=true is DEFAULT-DENY - it protects the critical_paths set against EVERYONE except TAG_TRUSTED (trusted_exes), and turns on the self-protection hooks (bpf()/module/mount/dev-mem/ptrace). protected_paths/critical_paths are directory/file prefixes (trailing slash auto-stripped). agent_exes are launcher basenames -> TAG_AGENT. exempt_exes are full exe paths -> TAG_EXEMPT (override inherited AGENT). trusted_exes are full exe paths -> TAG_TRUSTED (unrestricted, may call bpf(); MUST include the loader's own path).
_critical_comment: Enforced (against all-but-trusted) ONLY when hardening_mode=true. The shield's own state (pins + install dir) + credentials. Adjust the install-dir path to wherever the loader/bpf.o/config actually live on the target host.
_trusted_comment: MUST include the loader's own exe path or it cannot load/pin/unpin under hardening_mode. Set this to the deployed loader path.
